cairn/heaps.reason: the cairn field -- one heap per body recovered off this shore; a heap has a top and nobody stands on it

mud/heaps.reason: the heaps out in the mire, the same cairns the tide has already taken

stake/tops.reason: the iron tops of the tide-stake line: what the water is read against, never a step

crag/steps.reason: the crag's batter, stepping back one course in three -- a cliff read from the sand, and the reason the cut ledge is the only way up

shelf/coping.reason: the coping of the shelf's front wall and the head of the lamp cell, seen from the flat below
